summary: Fourth pass of the fuller enumeration. Chapter 6 (Department of State) and chapter 7 (Intelligence Community) were read in full and every concrete, checkable recommendation was matched against the existing records. Twenty-four further recommendations were researched, independently reviewed and scored blind for significance by two AI raters: 12 from each chapter. No candidate was dropped in review as a duplicate; partial overlaps are recorded as cross-references on both sides, including on 22 existing records. Review changed nine ratings. In chapter 6: c06-11 moved from proposed to implemented after reports that the China coordination office was kept under a new coordinator, and progress scores were lowered for c06-10, c06-13, c06-14 and c06-18. In chapter 7: c07-11 moved from in progress to no action found, c07-12 and c07-13 from diverged to proposed, c07-14 from in progress to proposed, and progress scores were lowered for c07-16 and c07-18. Review also corrected a research finding on c07-10 after reading the fiscal year 2026 intelligence authorization text. No recommendation text was changed in review, so no record needed rescoring. The new records count toward the headline, which now covers 281 recommendations.
